set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: O03.2
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer with institutional operator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Integrate all agreed identity, guest and session authority transitions with the O03.6 witness/adapter; retain the original complete authority-history acceptance and reuse the same journal, without a second implementation.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Capture agreed authority transitions with monotonic identity, attributable intent and idempotent replication to the configured independent store.
2. Enforce the specified acknowledgment/fail-closed behavior under journal outage and recover in-flight changes without accepting stale checkpoints.
3. Retain verified checkpoints and replay membership, stewardship, disablement and expiring grants; protect journal data and expose replication lag without secrets.
4. Extend O03.6’s exhaustive event inventory to verified identity binding changes, guest sponsorship/admission/expiry, account recovery and session invalidation from F04.3. Prove every supported producer follows the same commit/acknowledgment protocol and that current-profile installations upgrade through a fenced, complete enrollment without losing historical restrictions.
5. O03.6 completion is only the current-capability foundation. This task stays open until the F04.3 integration and real browser/session fault cases pass; a profile flag or unsupported-event refusal cannot substitute for implementing this final required coverage.

Verification: Fault injection before/after each local/remote durability boundary, reordered/duplicate events, missing suffixes and tampered-checkpoint tests.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.2/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O03.1: bd-01M4W5P9194RGNP7DFGHB7ZK09
- F03.2: bd-01M4W5P5GCCHC6ZMZ7MCGEJCW8
- F04.3: bd-01M4W5P64ZQD531177ZZKYVC4K
- O03.6: bd-01M4XPCN6RSRCS8CB96BR5Y8GY

Recovery-first amendment, 14 October 2026; original acceptance retained. O03.6-O03.8 deliver the current-capability path; full integration and institutional gates remain open.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
